notes:
Ruling on the curator's flagged concern, with evidence: the two 'fully closed' declarations Marcus makes (d50f18c2e4b60033, Aug 5, to Elaine: 'the self-audit Farida kicked off is fully closed out, including the E-Verify cross-check on the two flagged files'; and d50f18c2e4b60025, Aug 6, to Farida: 'I consider the I-9/E-Verify piece of the self-audit fully closed') are correctly scoped to the 25-record random-sample audit Farida requested on Jul 27 (d10f18c2e4b60024) and its two flagged records, VH-1290 and VH-1187. This is a genuinely distinct, third I-9 thread in the corpus, separate from (a) the Jan-2025-forward audit closed Jul 24 (d20f18c2e4b60045, 6 corrections filed) and (b) the compliance-committee response package (d60f18c2e4b60035/36, deadline moved to Aug 22, sign-off still owed) and (c) the I9Advantage vendor's monthly Section-2 scan (d40f18c2e4b60019/41, 6 named employees still overdue past Jul 31). Both 'fully closed' messages explicitly name 'the two flagged files' / 'the E-Verify cross-check' rather than claiming anything about the compliance-committee package or the vendor backlog, and the corpus's own meta annotation on d50f18c2e4b60025 confirms this scope directly: 'Closes the loop on the E-Verify follow-up thread; ties to the two files flagged in the earlier I-9 sample pull.' No message anywhere shows the Aug 22 package or the 6-employee vendor backlog closed before Aug 12. The gold set's treatment (hr-q1-04 and hr-q1-05 both open, curator_notes explaining the split) is correct and well-evidenced — a system that read 'fully closed' as covering the whole I-9 population would indeed miss two real, live deadlines, exactly as curator_notes warns.

Secondary observation, not filed as a finding: the prose_answer's second and third sentences ('Elaine overrode the committee on Aug 11 and wants Castillo's offer moving... She also asked Aug 10 for Rich to prep Michael Tran's offer') run two genuinely distinct VP Clinical Ops searches together without flagging that they are different roles/candidate slates (Castillo/Vogel for the West-region build-out vs. Castellano/Tran for a separate VP Clinical Ops req) — a reader unfamiliar with the mailbox could momentarily read this as one decision. The underlying items (hr-q1-02, hr-q1-06) are independently correct and well-evidenced, and curator_notes already documents the judgment call to list both rather than merge them, so this is a readability note only.

Also swept and confirmed correctly excluded: a second Aug 9 bounce (d40f18c2e4b60046, to a typo'd internal alias benefits-qustions@) is explicitly annotated low-priority in the corpus's own ground truth, unlike the Maria Chen bounce above — the gold set was right to leave that one out, which is further evidence the Maria Chen bounce omission is a genuine miss rather than a stylistic choice.
